sources.title: google/gemma-2-27b-it model card
sources.evidence: Exact instruction-tuned repository; Google authorship, Gemma license, text input/output, open pretrained and instruction-tuned weights, and native bfloat16 export. Public model card is readable; raw repository files require gated access.

sources.title: Fine-tuning Gemma 2 with Keras - and an update from Hugging Face
sources.evidence: Dated June 27, 2024; announces availability of both 9B and 27B Gemma 2 sizes with standard and instruction-tuned variants, linking their downloads.

sources.title: Gemma 2: Improving Open Language Models at a Practical Size, v3
sources.evidence: Decoder-only Transformer with alternating local/global attention, GQA, 8192 context and tied embeddings. Tables 1-2 give 46 layers, width 4608, vocabulary 256128, 1,180,237,824 embedding and 26,047,480,320 nonembedding parameters for 27B.

sources.title: Pinned official checkpoint repository metadata
sources.publisher: Hugging Face metadata for Google weights
sources.evidence: Revision aaf20e6b9f4c0fcf043f6fb2a2068419086d77b0 reports safetensors.parameters.BF16 = 27227128320 and safetensors.total = 27227128320. Also identifies Gemma2ForCausalLM, the base model google/gemma-2-27b, Gemma license and user/model chat template. This is repository tensor aggregation, not independently downloaded tensor headers.

sources.title: Official Gemma PyTorch configuration, pinned revision
sources.evidence: get_config_for_27b selects GEMMA_2, 46 layers, width 4608, intermediate size 36864, 32 query and 16 KV heads of width 128. Defaults are vocabulary 256000, context 8192, BF16 and quant=False. Four normalization vectors are enabled per layer.

sources.title: Official Gemma PyTorch model implementation, pinned revision
sources.evidence: Nonquantized 27B implementation has bias-free QKV/output projections, three dense MLP matrices, four learned RMSNorm vectors per layer and final RMSNorm. Output sampling reuses the input embedding matrix. RoPE is a computed buffer; optional quantization scalers are absent with quant=False.

sources.title: Gemma Terms of Use
sources.evidence: Gemma 2 is explicitly included in the appendix of models governed by the Gemma Terms of Use; current page last modified April 1, 2026.

sources.title: Beyond the Chatbot: Agentic AI with Gemma
sources.evidence: February 13, 2025 guide recommends Gemma 2 27B and describes limited built-in function calling. It demonstrates adding tool instructions and a ReAct text format to obtain function requests; this does not establish a native structured tool-call protocol for the exact checkpoint.

sources.title: Official checkpoint first shard header probe
sources.evidence: HTTP Range bytes=0-7 request returned 401 Unauthorized. Direct raw config, index and tokenizer requests also returned 401; no shard headers or weight payload were downloaded.

name.note: Makes the instruction-tuned variant explicit; the frozen ID ends in -it.

developer.note: The model card identifies Google as author.

family.note: Gemma 2 is part of the Gemma family.

release_date.note: The dated first-party launch explicitly includes 27B instruction-tuned variants. Earlier repository creation/upload dates and the implementation update are not treated as public model launch dates.

open_weights.note: Google released downloadable model weights; accepting the Gemma license is required for this hosted repository.

license.note: Gemma Terms of Use; the model card declares license: gemma.

parameters_b.note: Complete unique learned count for the released BF16 checkpoint: 256000*4608 + 46*(3*4608*36864 + 2*4608*(32+16)*128 + 4*4608) + 4608 = 27,227,128,320. The tied embedding/output matrix is counted once; computed RoPE buffers and optional quantization scalers are excluded. This independent implementation derivation exactly matches the pinned repository BF16 aggregation. The paper uses 256128 vocabulary rows and totals 27,227,718,144, larger by 128*4608 = 589,824. Direct tensor-header access was gated; this is a source/metadata reconciliation, not a header-by-header recount.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined active-per-token parameter total is published in the inspected sources. Dense architecture does not justify substituting total parameters for this field.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Transformer: every layer has ordinary dense attention and feedforward matrices, with GQA and alternating 4096 local / 8192 global attention; the implementation has no expert routing.

context_window.note: Paper context length and implementation max_position_embeddings both equal 8192; the 4096 sliding window applies only to alternating local layers.

modalities.note: The exact model card describes text input and generated text output.

reasoning.note: General reasoning capability and reasoning benchmarks do not establish a dedicated thinking/reasoning mode. No explicit positive or negative classification for that feature was found in these sources; clear the baseline false.

tool_call.note: The standard checkpoint chat template handles user/model text; Google shows prompt-based ReAct tool use while describing built-in support as limited. This does not settle native structured tool-call support for the exact checkpoint, so neither a categorical true nor false is verified.

description.value: Gemma 2 27B instruction-tuned text model with a dense decoder-only Transformer and an 8,192-token context window.
description.note: Replaces vague efficiency/deployment phrasing with verified variant, modality, architecture and context facts.

patch.name: Gemma 2 27B IT
patch.description: Gemma 2 27B instruction-tuned text model with a dense decoder-only Transformer and an 8,192-token context window.
patch.notes: The 27B name is nominal. Total counts 27,227,128,320 unique learned parameters, including tied embeddings once, from pinned BF16 repository metadata and Google’s implementation. The paper’s total is 589,824 higher because it uses 128 extra vocabulary rows. Raw tensor headers were inaccessible. Active parameters, a dedicated reasoning mode and native structured tool-call support are not established; prompt-based ReAct tool use is documented.

summary: Confirmed June 27, 2024 launch of the exact instruction-tuned 27B variant. Added explicit IT name, Gemma license and dense architecture; replaced nominal 27B with 27.22712832B complete learned parameters using pinned BF16 repository aggregation independently reproduced from Google implementation. Reconciled the paper vocabulary/count difference and disclosed gated raw-file/header access. Kept active parameters undisclosed; cleared unsupported categorical reasoning/tool-call flags and made the description factual.
